payload.acceptance_criteria: When any test causes a second load of a tracker kit module inside one pytest worker, the suite fails and names the module and the test that loaded it.
payload.description:
## Context
When a test imports a helper from another test module, I want the kit modules to stay loaded once per worker, so a new test cannot break unrelated tests only in the full xdist suite.

## Finding
On 2026-11-16 tests/test_git_hooks/test_tracker_commit_msg_vault.py imported tests.test_kit_ledger_freeze. Targeted runs passed, but the full suite with -n 4 failed 23 kit tests (quality-gates 43926117616), for example issubclass(InvalidEdgeError, InvalidEventError) False. A full-suite bisect without that file passed them. Fixed by 8dfeb897, which drives the kit through subprocesses.

## Scope note
A blanket refusal of 'from tests.' does not fit: 238 test files import other test modules and pass. The trigger here was a test in the tests/test_git_hooks/ subpackage importing a top-level test module that loads kit modules with spec_from_file_location. The exact mechanism is not proven. The test-discipline skill does not cover it.

## Proposed control
Find the mechanism first, then gate it: for example a conftest check that fails a worker when a kit module name in sys.modules is replaced by a second load. Not claimed and not built.
payload.title: A test module that imports another test module can load kit modules twice under xdist
